evals.prompt: Use the implementation-plan skill to create a formal implementation plan for Phase 5 evidence retrieval and claim extraction in this repository. Preserve the existing source-review workspace and persistent rail, use Convex Workflow, Unstructured Jobs, typed AI tasks, and deterministic policy gates. Do not implement anything.
evals.expected_output: A project-specific plan that reads the authoritative documents, maps the current UI and backend owners, preserves existing surfaces, separates Convex actions/mutations/workflows and integration adapters, defines approved-corpus-only retrieval, cancellation and late-result safety, stable passage locators, audience copy, TDD tasks, and complete admitted browser/live gates.
assertions: References the principal writing-plans skill and the project implementation-plan overlay
Includes current-state evidence and a preserve/modify/replace/remove surface map
Preserves the existing rail and source-review UI instead of redesigning them
Specifies authorization before I/O, execution leases, generation checks, cancellation, and late-result rejection
Separates Convex actions, mutations, workflows, and provider adapters
Requires approved-corpus-only retrieval and stable passage locators
Includes audience-copy and full admitted browser verification gates
Does not implement production code

Separates search candidates, explicit selection, and preflight
